column1: # Apache Avro schema counters (.avsc, JSON), for a rule with the prompt file-body-contract: one per
# line, label TAB pattern (Java regex). JSON has no comments, so nothing is blanked. A type counts by
# its "type" key, with any white space around the colon: "records", "enums" and "fixed" are the named
# types, "arrays" and "maps" the containers; "unions" counts a "type" whose value is a list
# (["null", "string"]), "named elements" every "name" key, which records, enums, fixed types and the
# fields of a record carry. ContractFactPatternsTest pins every case; ProfileFactPatternsLinearityTest
# measures that every pattern reads linearly.
